tagline: Command your squad from Hangar Bay 2 and board dropship DS-07 for the abandoned freighter.
description:
**STAR-Tech: Galaxy Infiltrators** opens in Hangar Bay 2, where dropship DS-07 waits with its ramp lowered and a squad of armored, rifle-carrying soldiers stands ready beside it. Beyond the hangar windows, open space and distant planets set the stage for what comes next.

The main menu reads *Command. Infiltrate. Neutralize.* From there you can jump straight into **Play**, choose from **Mission Select**, visit the **Enforcement Barracks**, or browse the **Robot Database**. Options, Credits, and Quit Game round out the menu.

A status panel tracks your **Squad Points**, your hero (**Hale**), and your difficulty setting, starting at **Recruit**. The Information Updates feed confirms systems are online, the squad is ready for deployment, and a new sector has opened: the **Abandoned Freighter**.
